# truenas_acl_template (Data Source)

Fetches a filesystem ACL template (builtin or user-created) by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `acl` (String) JSON array of Access Control Entries. See the resource schema for the exact shape.
- `acltype` (String) ACL type this template provides (NFS4 or POSIX1E).
- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether this is one of TrueNAS's built-in system templates.
- `comment` (String) Descriptive comment about the template's purpose.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the ACL template.
